verification_instructions: Run npm run build (tsc -b && vite build) and confirm zero errors
environment_constraints: No test framework. Verification is TypeScript compilation + Vite build success.
contribution_requirements: All pages use static mock data, no API calls, no randomness. Use dark theme tokens. Use existing Card component.
key_patterns: Pages use: lucide-react icons, recharts for charts, Card component from @/components/common/Card, flex gap layout with w-80 sidebar, static mock data at top of file, Tailwind CSS for all styling, dark theme colors (dark-bg #0f1117, dark-surface #1a1b2e, dark-card #1e2035)
directory_structure: dashboard/src/pages/ - all page components, dashboard/src/components/common/ - shared components like Card
